marta: quick sync — ran 13b quant (int8) + speculative decode (2-stage) on holdout cohort. Latency median down ~28%, p95 down ~22%. Quality: rouge/qa F1 stable on short prompts but droop ~1.8% on long (>=512) prompts. thinking this is KV-cache staleness + quant noise clustering.
jon: can you paste the exact config and perf dump?
marta: paste config and perf lines:
```yaml
model: titan-13b-int8
speculative:
  stages: 2
  probe_tokens: 8
  fallback_threshold: 0.35
batching:
  max_tokens: 1024
  adaptive_prefetch: true
```
Perf summary (holdout cohort):
Median latency: 84ms -> 61ms
P95: 210ms -> 164ms
Throughput: +12% tokens/s
Quality delta (avg): short(<128): -0.1%
                     mid(128-511): -0.6%
                     long(>=512): -1.8%
sam: thanks. How many seeds / runs? need random-seed variability.
marta: ran 3 seeds, each 10k prompts. variance small on latency, quality var ~0.4% between seeds. Longer prompts show higher variance.
kai: note: if speculative picks wrong early token, later KV prefill mismatch causes divergence; fallback threshold tuning critical. I saw similar on llama3 tests. propose: cohort bench by prompt-length buckets + by semantic difficulty (long code vs chit-chat).
jon: agree. propose new eval protocol:
- run N=5 seeds
- split holdout into len<128, 128-512, >=512
- measure token-wise logprobs delta, reject if mean delta > 0.05
- human spot-check 200 examples from failing bucket
sam: can we add calibrated regen tests? regen with temp 0.8 and 0.0 to surface hallucination shift.
marta: done. I'll run overnight. tagging @eng-oncall in case perf regressions spike :bell:
deploy-bot: CI run queued for spec-eval-job-1800012345 — logs will appear in /builds/spec-eval/1800012345
jon: perfect. If long-prompt regression persists, we should try raising probe_tokens -> 12 and fallback_threshold -> 0.25, and re-eval.
marta: noted. will post results tomorrow epoch.
